comments: In with scoters out in the forth
Not much to add really- there were 7 at the lagoons. The golden marks at the back made me think they were GWs

All on the River Esk mouth.

Very clear Ad. Winter bird seen far out, straight somewhat-thin bill with prominent contrasting black and white plumage on the neck. Cap seems to go down to the eyes, lore and auricular region. Neat lifer indeed.

Seen flying around the field between Hope Place And Old scrapes, very pale raptor with rounded wings and rapid wing beats. Seen chasing a bat around before eventually disappearing. No pictures were taken. Quite the surprising and unexpected lifer.
Flew over then landed distantly on the forth
Feeding at the very end of the Harbour wall
Briefest view of bird on kerb while driving. Front seen, looked good for Hooded with little sign of hybridisation. Obviously circumstances not ideal for a more thorough check
Around 40 in flight fairly high up. The twinkling of the wings in the low sun was amazing!
